text: 🚨🇲🇽 "It's a moment to defend Mexicans — or not defend them." The Senate, in a statement signed by every party, condemned the deaths of 17 Mexicans in US ICE operations and detention centers. — Claudia Sheinbaum, on the cross-party Senate statement Sheinbaum called for unity — differences on every other topic, but none on the human rights of Mexicans abroad. The PAN and PRI leaders answered by criticizing her, without a word of solidarity for the dead.

🇲🇽🌎 EUROPE OPENS UP: PARLIAMENT RATIFIES THE MODERNIZED MEXICO-EU GLOBAL AGREEMENT

The European Parliament approved the modernized Mexico-EU Global Agreement 479 to 119, clearing nearly all remaining tariffs — Mexico currently charges up to 45% on goods like cheese and pork — and opening preferential access for almost all Mexican exports: agrifood, autos, medical devices, pharma. Economy Minister Ebrard expects it in force this year, pending Senate ratification. As US tariffs bite, Mexico widens its doors elsewhere. (Data: El Financiero / El Economista)

🇲🇽🎓 MEXICO CITY: A UNIVERSITY TRANSPORT SCHOLARSHIP AS A RIGHT, NO STRINGS ATTACHED

Clara Brugada handed out the first 20,000 transport scholarships — 1,500 pesos every two months — on the way to 200,000 public-university students by year's end, on a 166-million-peso budget. No grade cutoffs, no income test: "Simply being a university student gives you the right to this support." A reform is underway to make it permanent.

🔥🇲🇽 EVEN THE EX-US AMBASSADOR ADMITS IT: NO EVIDENCE AGAINST SINALOA'S GOVERNOR

Ken Salazar now says he has "no indication" of any tie between Governor Rubén Rocha Moya and organized crime, and voiced respect for AMLO. Sheinbaum called it "interesting": the same US officials who spent years pushing a "narcogobierno" story now concede they had no knowledge. "The former ambassador is clearly saying: I had no knowledge."

🚨🇲🇽 MEXICO'S ATTORNEY GENERAL: THE FBI FED US FALSE DATA ON THE 'MAYO' ZAMBADA GRAB

FGR head Ernestina Godoy says US authorities "on several occasions gave false or imprecise information" about the July 2024 extraction of Ismael 'El Mayo' Zambada from Mexican soil — contradictory aircraft ID, an unauthorized runway, and a blocked inspection at FBI facilities in El Paso. If direct FBI participation is confirmed, she says, it is a violation of Mexican sovereignty and international law.

🔥🇲🇽 SUPREME COURT SHIELDS OPPOSITION GOVERNOR FROM CORRUPTION TRIAL — SHEINBAUM DEMANDS IT EXPLAIN WHY

Nuevo León's Congress opened a juicio político against Movimiento Ciudadano Governor Samuel García over alleged embezzlement and diversion of public funds. On July 13 the Supreme Court froze any removal or disqualification. Sheinbaum's answer: the Court must publicly detail the legal arguments that led it to block a corruption trial against a sitting governor.

🚨🇲🇽 MEXICO'S HOMICIDES DOWN 48% — 41 FEWER KILLINGS EVERY DAY

The daily homicide average fell from 86.9 to 45.4 between September 2024 and June 2026, the lowest June since 2015. Sonora is down 63%, Quintana Roo down 85%. Sheinbaum credits attention to root causes and zero impunity — 85 officials and ex-officials arrested since she took office, six of them sitting mayors.

THE BULWARK: An American Life Cut Short
July 9, 2026 | 🟢

📰 Bill Kristol's center-right Bulwark on Lorenzo Salgado Araujo — 35 years in Houston, a business owner who put three sons through university, killed by ICE. Its verdict: he was "a better American" than the men who killed him. 🇲🇽

Worth marking when it happens: parts of the US press, left and right, are mourning the man Mexico is now filing charges over — not running the fear-copy the killing usually generates.

• "He deserved to live a quiet life… a husband, father and a job creator for dozens of men"
• "I dare say Lorenzo Salgado Araujo was a better American than they are"
• his sons' motto, from him: "Give it your all, and never give up"

NEWSCHANNEL 10: Sinaloa connection — 4 indicted in Amarillo-to-Mexico gun pipeline
July 9, 2026 | 🟡

📰 Four people in Amarillo, Texas indicted for running guns to the Sinaloa cartel — bought at a Cash America pawn shop on I-40 through straw purchases, then smuggled south. 🇲🇽

The same US press that brands the cartels "foreign terrorists" rarely dwells on where their rifles come from: American gun stores. Mexico has made this "iron river" argument for years.

• charged with "material support" to a "foreign terrorist organization"
• the guns "purchased by Hall" then "smuggled into Mexico"
• a straw purchase — a legal buyer fronting for someone who can't buy

HOUSTON CHRONICLE: Key witness in fatal ICE shooting faces deportation
July 13, 2026 | 🔴

📰 ICE shot Lorenzo Salgado Araujo dead in a "mistaken identity" raid in Houston. Now his brother Victor — a key witness who says the agents never identified themselves — sits in detention, ordered removed to Mexico. 💀

Deport the witnesses and there's no one left to dispute ICE's account of how the homebuilder was killed driving his crew to a job site.

• "There are normal circumstances, and then there's what's going on here." — attorney Ruby Powers
• "I had to print off photos from the crime scene to show him in detention."
• "It's just shockingly, a totally different story." — Rep. Sylvia Garcia
